title: Lore
body:
This page is in need of cleanup!
You can help the Oaklands Wiki by editing it for clearness, conciseness, and clarity.
Note: This article is written like a blogpost (i.e. informally) and is in desperate need of someone who knows more about the lore to structure things more sensibly.

More information is needed to finish this page and lore is in question however there will be a few points mentioned that seem to imply lore.

The updates seem to be going backwards in time! Let me explain: the game started as one island; having few buildings and a lot of ruins scattered around. Mike's Mines was caved in. Mike Miner was there however and had dialogue along the lines of "Oh woe is me, Jenna [supposedly Mike's wife] has disappeared. My life is miserable without her." There was also a wanted poster for Jerry Junkman offering a tall refined axe reward; posted at The Oak Depot. A tunnel was seen behind the lighthouse leading you to a small island, that, when found, gives you the badge "A Familiar Place".

A new Island was introduced, adding new buildings and more ruins atop pillars of sandstone connected by ropes. Another update later, the lighthouse was in burning rubble.

Update! We got a single island with a ravine, bridged by the same operators as before; the Hyper Bridgeman and the Sleepy Bridgeman. The same old structures remain in the desert and plain new ruins are now found hinting that Alan's AutoLogistics is all rusty and looks like it's been closed forever. Mike's mines is no longer caved in and Jenna is now standing beside the shack just outside the mine. You can speak with her; she says "Have a safe travel down those mines!" The game gives you the option to say "Where have you been?" She responds with "What do you mean, silly? I have always been here!", which hints at deeper lore.

Another update and Alan's AutoLogistics is open for business, and now looks like the ruins went in reverse— no detail is left out. Half of the store is still closed, however.

If this is indeed a reverse time line the automobile half closed and logistics half remained. An earthquake closed the shop and it was left to rust. The island started sinking and Jenna disappeared and pirates stopped coming. The island continued to sink and became two separate islands. The light house was destroyed suspect being Jerry Junkman a warrant for his arrest was made and he hid at Jer's Junkyard later it was rebuilt. The bridge collapsed severing connection to Ferwater Island. The source of the backwards timeline (if there is any) is unknown.
